project.name: MCP Server SDK
project.summary: TypeScript SDK for building MCP servers with typed builders, protocol handling, transports, examples, tests, and release automation.
goals: Provide a type-safe, composable SDK for MCP tools, resources, prompts, notifications, sampling, elicitation, pagination, and transports.
Keep package exports, examples, tests, conformance behavior, and release automation aligned with the supported MCP protocol surface.
Use central ADR-29 admission and release workflows without embedding enterprise process policy in this repository.
nonGoals: Own the MCP specification, third-party client behavior, or consumer server product logic.
Own downstream package-specific tools, prompts, resources, or customer integrations.
Own enterprise doctrine, manifest schema, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

owns.name: mcp-server-sdk-package
owns.description: Package exports, source modules, builders, protocol helpers, transports, examples, tests, and benchmark scaffolding for @sylphx/mcp-server-sdk.

owns.name: mcp-protocol-implementation
owns.description: Repository-local JSON-RPC, MCP protocol, stdio transport, streamable HTTP transport, notification, sampling, elicitation, and pagination behavior.

owns.name: sdk-delivery
owns.description: ADR-29 CI wiring, conformance support, package build, and central reusable release workflow integration.

doesNotOwn: The upstream MCP specification, third-party MCP client behavior, or external conformance suite definitions.
Consumer server business logic, product-specific tools, prompts, resources, or customer integrations.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit
ADR-29 admission action and reusable release workflow
published package exports consumed by the SDK
published schema package exports consumed by the SDK

forbiddenCouplings: Do not require consumers to import internal source files instead of declared package exports.
Do not encode downstream product-specific tools, prompts, or resources into the SDK core.
Do not diverge from the documented MCP protocol surface without updating README, tests, and conformance evidence.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests and merge groups run .github/workflows/ci.yml with ADR-29 admission plus lint, typecheck, test, and build; main uses .github/workflows/release.yml to call the central reusable release workflow.
delivery.productionProof: Postsubmit ADR-29 proof exists, but npm/package readback, conformance result readback, and consumer smoke evidence are not yet documented as one release gate.

gaps.description: Document npm package readback, conformance evidence, and consumer smoke proof required after package release.
Record the supported MCP specification version and update policy as a durable project contract.
Add or generate API reference documentation from package exports so consumers do not rely on internal paths.
